sloka: यथारूपां यथावर्णां यथालक्ष्मीं च निश्चिताम् ।अश्रौषं राघवस्याहं सेयमासादिता मया ।। ५.३१.१५।।।।
transliteration: yathārūpāṁ yathāvarṇāṁ yathālakṣmīṁ ca niścitām ।aśrauṣaṁ rāghavasyāhaṁ seyamāsāditā mayā ।। 5.31.15।।।।

translations.english: "Surely I have seen here a lady of similar body, of similar complexion, of similar glow and beauty as described by Rama".
